objective: Complete the bounded Death Stranding donor transfer by making BODY/FIT loadout preparation answer route/environment friction without inventory scoring, body scoring, procurement, or safety claims.

donor.transferable_rule: PREPARE FOR THE ROUTE, NOT FOR INVENTORY COMPLETENESS.
non_transfer: digital loadout treated as physical safety proof

delta: BODY/FIT loads a browser-only route-friction projection beside existing PREP KITS without changing the canonical fitting/loadout state model.
Six optional frictions are available: carry/load, weather/exposure, power/charge, install/repair, mobility/traction, duration/service.
Each selected friction resolves against declared fitting label/capability/interface/service metadata and reports COVERED or UNANSWERED with exact matching modules.
Profiles persist locally per selected saved kit, or against the active unsaved loadout when no kit is selected.
RETIRED or superseded modules cannot satisfy route friction.
The projection explicitly reports terrain relation / no score / no safety claim and creates no purchase recommendation.

authority.route_friction: read-only relational projection + separate browser-local friction profile

proof.automated: body/fit/health-connect-selftest.cjs now proves POWER/WEATHER/MOBILITY coverage, INSTALL unanswered state, and exclusion of RETIRED modules alongside the existing Health Connect fixture.
proof.human_gate: none for correctness; any lived usefulness remains optional subjective evidence

falsifier: Remove the projection if it becomes an inventory-completeness score, starts implying safety/medical capacity, creates procurement pressure, or duplicates loadout preparation without reducing route-to-kit translation.
